name: DominoTT
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to multicall, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a short multi-step chain: flash loan WBNB, buy the token, abuse a meta-transaction/forwarder call with a reusable signature to invoke burn via multicall, sync the pair, and dump back to WBNB. It requires understanding the protocol-specific interaction between the token’s burn logic, the forwarder signature misuse, and AMM reserve syncing, so it is more than a trivial pattern but not deeply complex.
